reasons: Nvidia: Sunday 16:57 ET the board announced an independent investigation (committee of independent directors, outside counsel) into a reported foreign-intelligence effort targeting Huang; it 'has no reason to believe national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised' and expressed confidence in him. Huang told staff he was unfaithful to his wife and apologized. Trump called Huang 'honorable' and said he should stay; Beijing called the spy allegation a smear; three House committee chairmen asked for a closed-door briefing on 11-18; Gary Black doubts Huang keeps the job ('no natural successor'), Dan Ives calls it a 'black eye' overhang; Aletheia downgraded to Hold, Goldman reiterated Buy $300. NVDA reports 11-17 (6 sessions). A governance shock on the index's largest weight on a day the rest of the market gaps up: SPY's open-to-close depends on whether the NVDA selling spreads to the chain (SMH only -0.3% pre-market, AMD/AVGO/TSM up: so far it is not spreading) or stays idiosyncratic.
